text: Howie Dayton, Director, Community Recreation, and Angela Lopes, Supervisor, Community Recreation, Parks, Forestry and Recreation will give a presentation on Parks, Forestry and Recreation Response to Safe Outdoor Programming and Updated Communication Methods. The presentation will include information on the spring and summer outdoor program pilot, and subsequent updates to the web pages. An overview of accessibility features of Toronto.ca pages and future enhancements will also be provided.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
